sources.entry: Claude Usage - Menu bar app for Claude Code that keeps per-pane context (in the status line) and session/weekly usage always visible — no usage or context command to run. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Bread-bang/claude-usage) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Claude Usage - Menu bar app that shows your Claude Code usage — current session, weekly, Sonnet, and credits.

summary.one_liner: A lightweight native macOS menu bar app that shows Claude Code session and weekly usage, plus a live context readout in the Claude Code status line.
keywords: see how much claude code i have left
watch my context window fill up
pay as you go credits tracker
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the macOS menu bar and shows the current 5-hour session, the weekly usage (all models and Sonnet only), and pay-as-you-go credits, each with a utilization bar and reset time. It fetches this from the usage endpoint Claude Code uses, without launching Claude Code. It also adds a one-line status readout under the Claude Code prompt showing model, percent of context full, and tokens used (for example "Opus 4.8 · 11% · 113K/1M"), so users can run /compact before context fills. Each pane renders its own status line, so it works across tmux and cmux panes. The README says it reads the OAuth token from the existing Keychain item and makes no other network requests, with no analytics. Settings include a selectable icon, a refresh interval of 30s, 1m, or 5m, and a menu-bar number for a chosen window with traffic-light colors. It keeps the last good data when refreshes fail and backs off on rate limits.
use_cases: check Claude Code session and weekly usage without opening a terminal
monitor context window fill level in Claude Code
decide when to run /compact in a long session
see usage reset times at a glance on macOS
show Claude Code status line in tmux or cmux panes
how_to_run: swift run  (run from source, per Development section)
notable: Context readout in the Claude Code status line for each pane, with no Accessibility permissions needed
Usage data fetched from the same endpoint Claude Code uses, without spending Agent SDK credits
Reuses the OAuth token already in the macOS Keychain from Claude Code; no backend or telemetry
Pure Swift and SwiftUI with no Electron and no dependencies; notarized build
Does not overwrite another tool's status line in ~/.claude/settings.json
caveats: Relies on the undocumented api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage endpoint and Claude Code's Keychain format, which can change without notice
Requires macOS 13 or later and Claude Code signed in at least once
Only shows data for the Claude Code account signed in via the Keychain item; the claude.ai usage endpoint is deliberately not used
